titulo: The Gems and Pitfalls of Inflammatory Breast Disease: An Illustrated Review of Mastitis. What the Radiologist Should Know

fig.label: FIGURE 1
fig.caption: A 36‐year‐old woman presented with right breast pain during breastfeeding. Ultrasound reveals a retro areolar nodular lesion with irregular margins and hypoechoic appearance, initially suggestive of a breast abscess.
